gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Press Start 2P brings a retro, game-screen fun, its letters spaced like cut-outs pinned wide, with only a faint stroke shift up close. Noto Sans Grantha sits beneath it, tall and smooth, with bowls that never close up and snag the eye.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Press Start 2P is all arcade fun, with big open-looking bowls and strokes that barely vary, while Noto Sans Kaithi stays contemporary beneath it. Its lowercase fills the line.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-lao: Press Start 2P plays the retro joker, with spacing like pinned cut-outs. Noto Sans Lao follows with a towering x-height and mouths left wide open, so a long page would read smoothly and modern.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-mende-ki: Press Start 2P is the fun, retro one, its strokes tapering like wire rolled barely flat, best at making a loud first impression. Noto Sans Mende Kikakui is best at the quiet work, letting daylight through every curve while its lowercase stands tall.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-multani: Wide-set cut-out letters with big open-looking bowls give Press Start 2P its retro grin, and its joins thin only gently. Noto Sans Multani does the steadier job, with a lofty x-height and an e that gapes at its terminal.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Arcade fun meets clean office polish: Press Start 2P brings big open bowls and a faint brass-engraved contrast, while Noto Sans Myanmar sets a heavy-looking strip of text. The c opens broadly, so the retro top feels grounded.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-old-ital: Spacing like cut-out letters pinned wide is what defines Press Start 2P, with lightly modulated strokes and no harsh thin spots. Noto Sans Old Italic tucks its capitals close to the lowercase and keeps curve endings apart, so the retro headline hands off to something quiet.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-psalter-: Press Start 2P is fun and retro, with a faint but real thick-thin shift in its strokes. And Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi answers with gaping e shapes and barely rising capitals, an approachable counterweight to the game-like top line.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-saurasht: Big open-looking bowls and cut-out spacing make Press Start 2P instantly retro, with a measured thick-thin ratio underneath. Noto Sans Saurashtra brings the strongest quality of the pair, counters that stay connected to the outside and capitals barely taller than their neighbors.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Press Start 2P stands out for its cut-out spacing, wide and toy-like, with a slight swell on the bowls. Noto Sans Sunuwar tucks in beneath with short ascender stems and curves that leave open daylight, which softens the retro jolt above.
